messages.subject: renderPlot
parts:
Hi All,

I wonder if it is possible to use a recorded plot as an input for renderPlot()

Currently, renderPlot() allows an expression to <create> a plot, but suppose I have an already created plot, recorded via recordPlot(), would it be possible to send it to the web app?

Thank you,
Adrian
